# submission name:
fp4_mask_gen

# upload zipped `archive.zip`
[archive.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27186314/archive.zip)

# report.txt
```
=== Evaluation results over 600 samples ===
  Average PoseNet Distortion: 0.00063958
  Average SegNet Distortion: 0.00112878
  Submission file size: 249,624 bytes
  Original uncompressed size: 37,545,489 bytes
  Compression Rate: 0.00664858
  Final score: 100*segnet_dist + √(10*posenet_dist) + 25*rate = 0.36
```
The score _may_ change depending on the performance of the grading machine, but I'm not quite sure as I've only tested it on a single computer.

# does your submission require gpu for evaluation (inflation)?
yes

# did you include the compression script? and want it to be merged?
yes

# additional comments
Stores an AV1 CRF=55 brotli'd mask video (5-class SegNet output, 512×384, ~175 KB), uint16-quantized poses (~7 KB), and an FP4-quantized neural generator (~66 KB, ~88K params) that reconstructs both frames per pair from the decoded mask and pose via a depthwise-separable U-Net trunk with FiLM conditioning. Trained in three stages (frame2-anchor → frame1-finetune → joint QAT) with SegNet/PoseNet distortion losses.
